title: Model comparison parameters
description: Every number that acts in a model or profile comparison (bin/compare.py, F2c item E) and in the weekly model check. Defaults chosen before any result was seen; the owner may change them here, no code names them. Scores are on a 0 to 1 scale.

confidence.description: Confidence level of the interval on the mean paired difference (0.95 = a 95% interval). Strictly above 0.5 and below 1: bin/compare.py rejects the ends.

trials.description: Trials of each task for each arm.

pass_k.description: k of pass^k: the chance that k trials of a task all pass. Not above trials (bin/compare.py check).

margin.description: Non-inferiority margin: a cheaper arm is accepted when the lower bound of the interval stays above minus this.

min_tasks.description: Fewest paired tasks a comparison needs; fewer is inconclusive (min_sample).

routing_min_tasks.description: Fewest benchmark tasks of one link and role before the benchmark mean replaces the advertised score in routing.

stale_catalog_days.description: Age in days after which a provider model list counts as stale in the weekly check (read by item F).

regression_set.description: The rule for the regression set (tasks from failed cards that must keep passing).

min_pass_rate.description: Share of a set task's trials the candidate must pass; 1 means every trial.

event_chunk.description: Record digests in one trusted benchmark.recorded event line.

read_cap_bytes.description: The most bytes bin/compare.py reads of one input file (an arm or a regression file).

weekly.description: The weekly model check (F2c item F, bin/model_check.py) and the one engine exception of the apply contract (bin/stella_data.py frozen). Optional for the comparison library; the check refuses to run without it.

setting.description: The settings registry key of the owner setting that lets the check update built-in presets (boolean; unreadable counts as off).

engine_tool.description: The one script (path from the stack root) the apply tool lets use the engine exception.

pick_fields.description: The link lists of a preset role whose links the check may change.

pick_keys.description: The keys of a link a pick may change; nothing else of the preset changes but one appended changelog entry.

accept.description: The bin/compare.py decisions that accept a candidate with benchmark data, preferred first (non_inferior only ever comes for a cheaper candidate).

cheaper_tokens.description: The reference call whose price (bin/cost.py, pricing rows applied before the run) says which link is cheaper.

pick_id_prefix.description: The prefix of a pick id (the rest is random hex).

pricing_source.description: The source text of a pricing row the check appends; {connection} and {date} are filled in.

changelog.description: The changelog entry of a pick; {pick}, {role}, {field}, {index}, {old}, {new} and {reason} are filled in.

reasons.description: The plain text of each reason id the check reports (a pick, a refusal, a skip); an id with no text is shown as itself.
